name: @langwatch/identity-eventing
description: The identity platform's event-sourcing layer (ADR-101, ADR-115, ADR-116, ADR-117): the framework envelope over @langwatch/identity's fact payloads, the thin command handlers that run @langwatch/identity-server's guards, the fold projections, the two process managers, the four pipeline definitions the worker registers, and the Postgres binding of the two folds this package owns outright - the Identifier/MfaEnrollment head and the ScimSyncState head - behind postgres.*.adapter seams. Every factory still takes its stores and ports as arguments; the app supplies the connection-teardown and join-lifecycle ports.
